title: tdh.synth.1oscil~
description: `tdh.synth.1oscil~` is a single-oscillator synth voice, intended as a building block for a larger synthesizer. Its waveshape, octave range, frequency or pitch, volume, modulation depths, and glide can be controlled through its GUI or external messages, while signal inlets accept frequency modulation (vibrato) and amplitude modulation (tremolo).
